half-hours-with-great-story-tellers-arte: A turn-of-the-century anthology pulls together short comic sketches and stories from some of the 1800s' funniest writers. Artemus Ward's sly American humor, George MacDonald's fairy-tale touch, Samuel Lover's Irish wit, and Max Adeler's tall tales all appear side by side. The pieces were picked to be read aloud in about half an hour each — light entertainment meant for the whole family parlor.
